title: error inside an imported file
notes: Reports sub/imported.pdl:4, the line the expression is on. Until phase-3 item 0 it reported `sub/imported.pdl:1`: `execute_call` built the callee's location out of the callee's file and path and the CALLER's line table, the lookup missed, and `get_line`'s ancestor walk turned the miss into a confident wrong line (DROP #6). `PdlLocationType` no longer carries a table, so that location cannot be spelled; the entry is now the regression test for it. Location 1 -> 2 with phase-3 item 7: the previous note recorded that the line was already right and only the column, the block path and the import chain were missing, and `  in defs.f.return` supplies the second of those. It is the most useful path in the corpus -- it says the failure is inside function `f`, which the file and line alone do not. Still not 3: no column, no excerpt, and no chain saying `prog.pdl:5` called it.
